name: YFG Stranje [Flux | Krea2]
description: YFG Stranje (Flux.2 Klein 9B) – Painterly Sci-Fi / Fantasy Illustration Style A “storybook-meets-concept-art” illustration LoRA: painterly ink + wash / watercolor feel with gritty mechanical detail. Expect hand-painted textures , sketchy linework, parchment/paper vibes, and bold focal subjects (helmets, masks, pilots, armored figures, creatures, walkers, ships) often framed like a collectible illustration plate. Trigger No dedicated trigger word. “YFG-Stranje” (sometimes seen as “YFG-Strange”) was present in dataset captions, but it’s not required . If you include it anyway, treat it as a style cue , not a strict trigger. Strength Tested 0.5 – 2.5 1.5 is a great all-around setting (strong style + good prompt fidelity) 2.0 gives excellent strong results with surprisingly little degradation Above that can still work, but expect heavier stylization and more “Stranje takeover” Key Characteristics Painterly plate look – illustration/postcard framing, warm paper tones, gentle vignette. Grit + beauty – detailed armor plating, weathering, rivets, textiles, scratches. Cinematic subjects – masked faces, pilots, armored wanderers, beasts, odd machines, airships. Warm accents – oranges, ambers, dusty reds, with muted cool shadows. Illustration-first rendering – feels “crafted,” not purely photoreal. Prompt Ideas “A lone desert pilot in a weathered helmet, painterly sci-fi illustration, ink and wash, warm parchment background.” “An armored guardian with ornate mask and filigree plating, concept art plate, watercolor texture.” “Strange biomechanical insect in a ruined marsh, illustrated field-guide page, subtle linework.” “Floating fortress airship above storm clouds, hand-painted sci-fi fantasy illustration.” “Portrait of a cyber-knight with ceremonial armor, warm highlights, paper texture, detailed brushwork.” Tips & Tricks Describe it like an illustration Add cues such as “painterly,” “illustration,” “ink and wash,” “watercolor,” “concept art,” “paper texture,” “hand-painted.” Pick strong hero subjects It really shines on portraits, masks/helmets, armored characters, creatures, walkers, ships. Control stylization with weight 0.8–1.2 : mild enhancement / keeps more base model realism 1.5 : signature Stranje look 2.0 : bold, highly “illustrated plate” energy Composition cues help Use “centered hero,” “full-body character sheet,” “three-quarter portrait,” “illustration plate,” etc. If it “over-stylizes” Lower weight (try 1.2–1.4 ) and reduce extra style words—let the LoRA do the work. YFG Stranje is a style-forward LoRA that turns prompts into rich, painterly sci-fi/fantasy illustration plates —especially strong for characters, armor, masks, creatures, and strange machines. Start at 1.5 , push to 2.0 when you want it to really show up.
